en.title: Technical relevance and regional context
en.notice: Global technical relevance means applicable product or dependency conditions across jurisdictions, not confirmed worldwide victims. Regional sections describe the focus of the case, not an exclusive impact boundary. This classification audit uses saved evidence; it is not a new collection or revalidation of every report. Original timestamps, uncertainty and retained historical context still apply.
